The photo shows a bowl of porridge or oatmeal with some orange bits, probably carrot or dried fruit. The bowl looks about 15–16 cm across, and the porridge fills most of it. I'd guess about 300 g of cooked porridge. Cooked oatmeal made with water is roughly 70 kcal per 100 g, and one made with milk or with extra ingredients is closer to 90 kcal per 100 g. I'll use about 80 kcal per 100 g, which gives roughly 240 kcal.
